title: Cap's Year in Love
old_caption: Capricorn's year in love, in slides. Say how I feel: done, once. Rest: working on it. Then Sag showed up with a review of its own. What's your goal for next year?

title: Virgo, voice note, take four
old_caption: Four takes, one handwritten script, one neighbour's dog, and the final answer was a text. Fourteen minutes well spent. Who else rehearses a voice note like it's a speech?

title: Gemini typed LMAO with a straight face
old_caption: Laughed out loud on the bus for the crush's cat story. Typed LMAOOOO for the friend's fog joke with a perfectly blank face. Which friend gets your real laugh?

title: Leo checked their reflection mid-date
old_caption: The window, the spoon, the phone screen: three reflection checks before the story about the dog even ended. Then the date pulled out a pocket mirror. Match made?

title: Cancer saved a 'gn' screenshot
old_caption: One 'gn :)' got zoomed to 400%, archived, printed and framed on the wall. The folder is at 48 now. What's the most screenshotted text on your phone?

title: Aries replied in 0.3 seconds
old_caption: The phone buzzed and Aries cleared the couch in one dive. The play-it-cool timer lasted nine seconds. Then they replied just as fast. Fast texter or slow texter?

title: Taurus said 'on my way' from bed
old_caption: 'On my way!!' sent from under a blanket. Leaving in 5, then 10, then 15. Then the friend sent a photo from their own bed. Who in your group texts it first?

title: The Libra committee answers 'hey'
old_caption: Four drafts, one whiteboard, a vote, a recount and a tearful Pisces tie-break. Two hours later, the 'hey' was meant for someone else. Who's on your reply committee?

title: Sagittarius planned the trip after one chat
old_caption: Ten minutes of talking at a party and there was already a map, an itinerary and matching luggage. Day one: learn their name. Who plans the whole trip after one good chat?

title: Capricorn scheduled a feelings slot
old_caption: A calendar block that says FEEL FEELINGS, 3:00 to 3:15. At 3:00 it was everything at once. By 3:16 the meeting was extended indefinitely. Who else books time to have a crush?
